title: Measure offline semantic retrieval against the lexical baseline
steps: Add paraphrased fictional evaluation cases without changing the existing baseline cases.
Implement the smallest offline embedding retrieval path using the pinned MiniLM model.
Validate dimensions, finite values, citations, source filtering, and deletion after restart.
Report paired lexical versus semantic Recall@5 and fallback behavior.
Add focused tests and run the existing full verification suite.
